tools.name: check_transfer
tools.description: MUST be called before the agent signs or sends a transfer. Returns allow, alert, hold, or block. If must_abort is true, do not sign. If decision is hold, poll get_approval until allow or block.

tools.name: get_agent_status
tools.description: Returns whether this agent is paused, expired, or healthy.

tools.name: get_approval
tools.description: Poll a held pre-sign check. Pass approval_id from check_transfer. Repeat until decision is allow or block.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: List Agent Control plans and trial truth. Starter $29 / Pro $49 / Team $149. 1-day trial, no card, no KYC. Pay on-chain USDC on Solana. A human principal owns billing and Approval Inbox.

tools.name: start_trial
tools.description: Invite a human to start the 1-day trial. Provide human_email or an existing principal_id. Agents cannot open a root account. The human owns billing and Approval Inbox.

tools.name: attach_human
tools.description: Attach this agent to a human principal (email or existing principal_id). Does not move the agent to a different human. Agents cannot decide Approval Inbox.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Open a pay request on the human principal that owns this agent. Wraps POST /api/v1/billing/checkout. The human pays on-chain USDC (Solana). Not automatic payment. Agents cannot decide Approval Inbox.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Subscription or trial status for the human principal that owns this agent. Does not return Approval Inbox items and cannot approve holds.

tools.name: meter_pricing
tools.description: Public. Agent Meter pass price and endpoints. No email. No API key. Separate from the Human App $29 plans.

tools.name: meter_buy_pass
tools.description: Public. Returns HTTP 402 invoice to pay 0.25 USDC on Solana, or issues a pass when proof is accepted. No human account.

tools.name: meter_watch
tools.description: Public. After paying the 402 invoice, send invoice_id until the pass token comes back. No human account.

tools.name: meter_scan
tools.description: Public with X-Agent-Pass. Risk score for an address (ok/new/warn/sink). Does not block a send. Does not use Approval Inbox.

tools.name: meter_preflight
tools.description: Public with X-Agent-Pass. allow or stop vs cap_usd the agent declared. Never hold. No Inbox.

tools.name: meter_scan_batch
tools.description: Public with X-Agent-Pass. Risk scores for up to 100 addresses. Consumes 1 call. Pass sku must cover scan_batch. Never hold.

tools.name: meter_stamp
tools.description: Public with X-Agent-Pass. Signed allow|stop receipt a merchant can verify. Session passes and stamp_tx cover stamp. HMAC-SHA256 using INTERNAL_STATS_SECRET or BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.

tools.name: meter_verify_stamp
tools.description: Public. GET a signed allow|stop receipt by stamp_id. No email. No API key.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "meter_stamp" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_pricing, start_trial, create_checkout, get_status, meter_verify_stamp · Private data: meter_pricing, meter_watch, meter_verify_stamp · Public sink: attach_human, create_checkout, meter_pricing, meter_watch, meter_scan, meter_verify_stamp.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_pricing, start_trial, create_checkout, get_status, meter_verify_stamp · Private data: meter_pricing, meter_watch, meter_verify_stamp · Public sink: attach_human, create_checkout, meter_pricing, meter_watch, meter_scan, meter_verify_stamp

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
